feature: Grounded AI, language, vocabulary and user control

scenarios.name: Keep saved conversation instructions
scenarios.given: a conversation has custom summary instructions
scenarios.when: it is archived and reopened
scenarios.then: the same instructions survive while older archives remain readable

scenarios.name: Keep Ask separate from summaries
scenarios.given: a conversation already has summaries and review state
scenarios.when: the user taps a suggested question
scenarios.then: a separate answer is generated without changing summaries or review state

scenarios.name: Protect custom-server credentials
scenarios.given: an API key is associated with a custom server origin
scenarios.when: a request targets another scheme, host or port
scenarios.then: the key stays bound to its original origin

scenarios.name: Bind each cloud service to its own credentials
scenarios.given: several cloud presets have credentials
scenarios.when: the user switches between vendors
scenarios.then: each vendor uses its own origin-bound Keychain item

scenarios.name: Respect a fixed transcription language
scenarios.given: the user has chosen a fixed language
scenarios.when: automatic detection proposes another language
scenarios.then: the fixed language is never overridden

scenarios.name: Preserve per-conversation vocabulary
scenarios.given: a conversation has domain and personal vocabulary
scenarios.when: it is archived, transformed and exported
scenarios.then: its vocabulary survives those transformations

scenarios.name: Summarize the selected evidence
scenarios.given: the user selects timed transcript lines with speakers
scenarios.when: a selection-summary request is assembled
scenarios.then: the prompt includes only those selected lines with their provenance

scenarios.name: Keep independent live and summary translation targets without replacing originals
scenarios.given: a conversation has original English speech, opt-in French live translation and a Traditional Chinese target for the Summary page
scenarios.when: the conversation is archived and reopened, renamed or re-transcribed
scenarios.then: both translation choices survive while original speech, AI provider settings and previous summaries remain authoritative

scenarios.name: Translate finalized speech only after opt-in
scenarios.given: original speech includes a completed line and partial words, with translation off
scenarios.when: the user enables French translation and more speech arrives
scenarios.then: only finalized lines are translated once, original wording and speaker identity remain intact, and disabled translation never processes content

scenarios.name: Explain missing or unsupported translation packs without processing text
scenarios.given: the selected on-device language pair needs preparation or is unsupported
scenarios.when: live translation is enabled
scenarios.then: the user sees the pair-specific recovery reason and no translation or automatic model download starts

scenarios.name: Keep late translations out of changed conversations
scenarios.given: a native translation is held while original speech remains visible
scenarios.when: translation is disabled, its target changes, a line is edited/deleted or another conversation opens
scenarios.then: the held result cannot overwrite current content or recreate a deleted line and at most one native job remains active

scenarios.name: Native translation checks exact installed pair before sending text to the local model
scenarios.given: the Apple language adapter reports installed, download-required or unsupported pairs
scenarios.when: translation is requested for an original English line with an explicit French target
scenarios.then: only the installed pair receives original text; the other states explain recovery and cannot construct a translation request or substitute languages

scenarios.name: Native phone and tablet controls preserve original text in portrait and Duo
scenarios.given: an original synthetic conversation and installed or setup-required translation pairs
scenarios.when: the user opens live translation controls, chooses French and rotates the device
scenarios.then: original and translated final lines remain visible in portrait and wide layouts, controls remain reachable and missing packs show Prepare without automatic download or microphone start

scenarios.name: Suspend translation when the phone backgrounds
scenarios.given: a phone translation is held and more finalized speech is waiting
scenarios.when: the app backgrounds and later becomes active
scenarios.then: no late result publishes and no queued native work starts in the background; foreground resumption uses the current conversation choices

scenarios.name: Mac language controls bind to the real conversation without starting audio or AI
scenarios.given: a narrow native Mac language panel and original English speech
scenarios.when: the native shared control binding enables French transcript translation with Japanese summary-translation target selected
scenarios.then: the actual session translates the original line locally without capture or AI, keeps the independent summary-translation target and original speech, and renders narrow controls; installed Mac interaction remains separate acceptance

scenarios.name: Translate the existing summary only from an explicit Summary page option
scenarios.given: an existing original summary with headings, bullets and a code block
scenarios.when: the user opens Summary, chooses French and requests translation
scenarios.then: opening alone sends no text, requested prose is translated locally while formatting/code and original text remain intact, and closing translation restores the original-only view

scenarios.name: Refuse stale or unprepared summary translations
scenarios.given: translation is held or its on-device packs are missing
scenarios.when: the source, target or conversation changes, the summary is being generated, or packs are prepared and retried
scenarios.then: stale results never replace current summary text, streaming drafts are not translated, missing packs send no content and explicit retry can resume installed-pair translation

scenarios.name: Translate from the native Summary page without replacing the original
scenarios.given: a completed original summary on iPhone or iPad
scenarios.when: the user opens Translate summary, chooses French, requests translation and closes it
scenarios.then: translation is explicit, both texts are readable and closing restores original-only viewing without capture or AI generation; at largest text missing packs explain setup without automatic downloads and Close returns to a reachable original; scrolling at largest text reveals whole action buttons before tapping rather than relying on a clipped hit target

scenarios.name: Keep native summary translation separate from generation and save its choices
scenarios.given: a saved phone summary and independent translation choices
scenarios.when: the user translates then reopens or starts New, or changes only a target before autosave
scenarios.then: the original summary is saved unchanged, translated text is not archived, choices survive reopening and target-only changes make the checkpoint dirty

scenarios.name: Closing the Mac window suspends both translation workers
scenarios.given: held live and summary translations with queued original text
scenarios.when: the window closes and later returns
scenarios.then: held results and backlog cannot publish while closed, reopening resumes current choices and originals stay intact

scenarios.name: Keep code inside longer Markdown fences verbatim
scenarios.given: a completed summary with four-character code fences, shorter embedded fences and invalid closing text
scenarios.when: the summary is translated
scenarios.then: only prose outside a valid matching fence reaches translation and all code stays verbatim
